about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Beneath The Six. A magical world where dice make up the core of every living soul which inhabits it and treasured relics sit at the bottom of a monster ridden dungeon.

Beneath The Six is a traditional rogue-like experience with a single randomised daily dungeon and 4-player co-op. Collect sets of dice and use them to create the best fighter, mage or rogue you can in an attempt to fulfil the dungeons challenges. Earn rewards to unlock more dice sets to expand your collection or trade amongst your friends.

Collect Dice

Unpack and collect beautiful sets of mystical dice from a pool of 135 sets. Purchase sets from our store or unbox random ones from dice chests. Hunt down the rarest dice, including 12 legendary sets!

Unique Character Creator

Using your dice sets you can create a huge range of characters with differing skills, armours, weapons and stats to take on the dungeon. Each individual dice in a set provides a specific component to your character so you can mix and match them how you see fit.

Procedural Daily Dungeon

Beneath The Six features a procedurally generated dungeon containing randomised challenges, monsters and loot. The dungeon regenerates itself every 24 hours, and not every dungeoneer is up to the task of reaching the bottom of the dungeon every day. It is your challenge to find the right build for the job!

Party Up and Explore With Friends

Beneath The Six supports 4-player co-op, allowing you to tackle the dangers of the dungeon with backup, and show off your new characters.

Endure Daily Challenges

Complete weekly and daily challenges in the dungeons to earn rewards which will allow you to unlock more dice sets.

short_description: Beneath The Six is a traditional roguelike set in a fractured world long-forgotten by space and time. Collect powerful dice sets and use them to forge valiant adventurers to explore daily randomised dungeons full of trinkets, traps and treasures.
